releaseNotes: v1.20.0: the reliability release. File and voice-note delivery rebuilt to be bulletproof: transfers auto-retry through network blips, recover after app restarts, and keep re-sending until they arrive — even if the other phone sleeps for days. Big files up to 50MB now send smoothly without freezing the app. New fullscreen video player with tap-to-show controls, 10-second skips and a draggable seek bar. Voice recorder waves now dance with your voice in a bigger, livelier animation. Failed transfers show a clear tap-to-retry, unplayable audio says so, and deleted messages can no longer reappear.
